title: Integral scalar square for the selected normalized pullback family
statement: An allowed scheme $W$ is noetherian, satisfies $\dim(W)\leq n$ for some $n\in\mathbf N$, and has $\ell$ a unit in every structure-sheaf stalk, as in [lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization]. Fix l prime, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, coefficient comparison data C_T for all allowed schemes, an IntegralComparisonSystem R and a family P_h of FdPullbackSystem for all allowed scheme isomorphisms. Suppose every finite component satisfies FdPullbackRoosMatching for R. For any $h:U\xrightarrow{\sim}T$, finite $E\subseteq L$ and integral constructible K over E on T, the ambient inverse-b scalar square holds: C_U(P_h,E.ambient) followed by C_U.integral_scalar and the transported integralPullbackScalarComparison equals the inverse actual PBC scalar-completed-pullback comparison, followed by PBC pullback of C_T.integral_scalar and P_h,L.ambient on the extended object. There is an alpha witness on the ambient presentations whose hom is HEq to pbcScalarCompletedPullIso; the equation is HEq in exactly those presentations, as specified by the explicit Lean statement. Definitions are those of [def-fd-coefficient-comparison-datum], [def-fd-pullback-comparison-datum], [def-fd-finite-pullback-comparison-datum], [lem-fd-pullback-augmentation-counit-matching], [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization] and [def-fd-integral-pullback-shift-coordinates].

source.place: Whole-tower argument, steps 8--10: transfer the completion-conjugated scalar square to the selected ambient finite components. Auxiliary proof extracted from lem-fd-whole-tower-integral-pullback-comparison.

proof.text: Choose common strict-tower models at E and L by fdPullbackCommonStrictTowerModels and ordinary coefficient transports by fdScalarPullbackRealizationIdentification. Apply fdScalarRoosIntegralIntertwining to obtain its completion-conjugated scalar square.

Identify the selected finite ambient hom components with the inverse common-model components by fdPullbackRoosMatching_uniqueness. Identify the selected integral scalar components with c inverse followed by transported chi by fdCoefficientScalar_completionIdentification.

Precompose the existing square with scalar(bE inverse), cU inverse and transported chiU; postcompose with pullback(transported chiT) and bL inverse. Cancel the adjacent isomorphism pairs. The resulting equation is exactly the requested inverse-b square. Identify the two completed coefficient maps by their equal finite quotient projections, and transport the scalar-completed-pullback isomorphism along these functor equalities. Equality elimination supplies the required HEq witness and equation.

lean.statement:
theorem fdNormalizedPullbackIntegralScalar (R : IntegralComparisonSystem.{u} l)
    (C : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
      [Fact (∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim T ≤ n)]
      [Fact (∀ t : T, IsUnit (l : T.presheaf.stalk t))],
      FdCoefficientComparison l Ω T)
    (P : ∀ {U T : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian U] [IsNoetherian T]
      [Fact (∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim U ≤ n)]
      [Fact (∀ t : U, IsUnit (l : U.presheaf.stalk t))]
      [Fact (∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim T ≤ n)]
      [Fact (∀ t : T, IsUnit (l : T.presheaf.stalk t))]
      (h : U ≅ T), FdPullbackSystem l Ω (C U) (C T) h)
    (_matching : ∀ {U T : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian U] [IsNoetherian T]
      [Fact (∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim U ≤ n)]
      [Fact (∀ t : U, IsUnit (l : U.presheaf.stalk t))]
      [Fact (∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim T ≤ n)]
      [Fact (∀ t : T, IsUnit (l : T.presheaf.stalk t))]
      (h : U ≅ T) (E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω),
      FdPullbackRoosMatching l Ω (C U) (C T) h E R ((P h).finite E)) :
    ∀ {U T : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian U] [IsNoetherian T]
    [Fact (∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim U ≤ n)]
    [Fact (∀ t : U, IsUnit (l : U.presheaf.stalk t))]
    [Fact (∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim T ≤ n)]
    [Fact (∀ t : T, IsUnit (l : T.presheaf.stalk t))]
    (h : U ≅ T) (E L : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω) (e : E ≤ L)
    (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) T),
    ∃ alpha : pbcAmbientScalarExtension l Ω T e ⋙
        pbcActualCompletedPull h.hom (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω L) ≅
      pbcActualCompletedPull h.hom (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω E) ⋙
        pbcAmbientScalarExtension l Ω U e,
    HEq alpha.hom
      (pbcScalarCompletedPullIso l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E)
        (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω L) (pbcFiniteFieldInclusion l Ω e) h.hom).hom ∧
    HEq
      ((pbcAmbientScalarExtension l Ω U e).map
          (((P h).finite E).ambient.hom.app K) ≫
        ((C U).integral_scalar e).hom.app
          ((constructibleIntegralPullback l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E) h.hom).obj K) ≫
        (integralDetailedTransport U l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω L)).map
          (integralPullbackScalarComparison l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E)
            (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω L) (pbcFiniteFieldInclusion l Ω e) h.hom K).hom.hom)
      (alpha.inv.app
          ((integralDetailedTransport T l (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E)).obj K.obj) ≫
        (pbcActualCompletedPull h.hom (pbcStageDatum.{u} l Ω L)).map
          (((C T).integral_scalar e).hom.app K) ≫
        ((P h).finite L).ambient.hom.app
          ((sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension 0 l
            (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime)) (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω E)
            (pbcFiniteField.{u} l Ω L) (pbcFiniteFieldInclusion l Ω e) T).obj K))
